title: Multimodal-Multiresolution Foundation Model for Lunar Remote Sensing
abstract: arXiv:2609.13283v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present a multimodal foundation model for lunar remote sensing, pretrained from scratch on SomBench, a geographically partitioned corpus of nearly two million co-registered tile bundles spanning 11 modalities at two spatial scales (1 m/pixel and 100 m/pixel). The model adapts the TerraMind masked-token architecture with two lunar-specific extensions: acquisition geometry is provided as explicit context, and meter- and hundred-meter-scale tiles are trained jointly so that a single set of weights covers both resolutions. FlexiViT patch embeddings allow adaptation to different patch sizes without retraining, while modality-wise inputs enable flexible multimodal fine-tuning. Qualitative generation experiments suggest the model learns meaningful cross-modal correspondences, including terrain derivatives from elevation and illumination-consistent reflectance from geometry. We evaluate on four benchmarks: crater detection at WAC and NAC sc

translated_title: 面向月球遥感的多模态-多分辨率基础模型
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种用于月球遥感的多模态基础模型，该模型在SomBench上从零开始预训练。SomBench是一个按地理分区的语料库，包含近两百万个空间配准的瓦片数据包，涵盖两种空间尺度（1米/像素和100米/像素）下的11种模态。该模型基于TerraMind掩码标记架构进行改造，并加入了两项针对月球的特定扩展：将成像几何条件作为显式上下文输入，以及联合训练米级和百米级瓦片，使单一权重集能够覆盖两种分辨率。FlexiViT补丁嵌入使模型无需重新训练即可适应不同的补丁大小，而按模态划分的输入则支持灵活的多模态微调。定性生成实验表明，该模型学习到了有意义的跨模态对应关系，包括从高程数据生成地形衍生产品，以及从几何信息生成光照一致的反射率影像。我们在四个基准数据集上进行了评估：WAC和NAC影像上的陨石坑检测……
tldr: 该研究提出了首个面向月球遥感的多模态-多分辨率基础模型，通过在涵盖11种模态、两种空间尺度的近两百万样本语料库上从零预训练，并引入成像几何上下文与跨分辨率联合训练等月球特定扩展，实现了单一模型对米级和百米级月球遥感数据的统一处理。
en_tdlr: This work presents the first multimodal-multiresolution foundation model for lunar remote sensing, pretrained from scratch on a corpus of nearly two million co-registered tile bundles spanning 11 modalities at two spatial scales, with lunar-specific extensions including explicit acquisition geometry context and joint training across resolutions, enabling a single set of weights to handle both meter- and hundred-meter-scale lunar remote sensing data.
